replies.author: Juzzaman
replies.body: Can this add layers to an animation? I have a workflow where I'd like to have a base sprites, Like a very bare bones guy in a loin cloth. I'd like to generate a bunch of animations walking, attakc, etc. And then add my chainmail or sword to it. I need the animation to stay consistent and have these equipment as different layers I can add and remove.

replies.author: Capital-Meringue-168
replies.body: For consistent base + swappable equipment, splitting the generation tends to hold up better than one pass with layers. Generate the base loop with a locked seed first, then run the equipment passes using the base sequence as ControlNet pose conditioning, and composite in-engine. Brittle around occlusion in my experience (sword crossing the body) but the loops themselves usually stay consistent.

replies.author: Juzzaman
replies.body: Try nearest neighbour and upping the colours a bit
